name: Anneliese Weber
bio:
Anneliese Weber's motorsport journey began unexpectedly, volunteering at a local hill climb event after a career in general freight logistics. Her knack for organization and problem-solving quickly shone through, leading to an offer from a smaller rally team. Years of experience navigating complex schedules and coordinating equipment for various teams led her to Hansen World RX Team. 

Anneliese thrives on the fast-paced environment of rallycross, approaching every challenge with a methodical and adaptable mindset. She prides herself on anticipating potential logistical bottlenecks before they arise, ensuring the team's operations run smoothly, both at the track and in transit. Her calm demeanor under pressure and meticulous attention to detail make her an invaluable asset.

What sets Anneliese apart is her unwavering commitment to efficiency. She's always looking for ways to optimize processes, from streamlining customs paperwork to finding the most cost-effective shipping routes. She's a true logistics guru, ensuring that the team gets what it needs, where it needs it, when it needs it.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, slightly wavy, often tied back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Anneliese is of average height with a practical, no-nonsense appearance.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with logistical checklists and flowcharts.
Has an uncanny ability to predict delays in shipping and customs.
Insists on labeling every piece of equipment with multiple backup labels.
